bio: Shopping and fine dining under one roof? Head to the top floor of the engelhorn Mode im Quadrat department store for precisely that. A team headed up by Dominik Paul cooks modern and creative cuisine. The dishes bowl over diners with flavours that range from bold and robust to low-key, subtle and highly elegant. Made using excellent ingredients, everything is nicely pared down and wonderfully balanced. Clever wine pairings – that accompany, for example, the wagyu, sepia, sake, salmon, oyster, kohlrabi or beef, mushroom, bone marrow – also make an impression with a few surprises. In the evening, there is the six-course set menu, Urban Nature, and the four-course set menu, Chef's Choice.
